rationale: The hook's outer sh -lc re-imposed exactly the replace-PATH semantics the launcher fix removes — a non-passthrough ~/.profile destroyed the inherited PATH before the launcher ran, so the probe could report runner=none (false warning) for a spawn that succeeds. Direct spawn restores the recorded probe-mirrors-spawn-exactly principle: the real spawn is sh -c with recovery inside the launcher, so the probe must be too. Supersedes the mechanism of the 2026-07-20 decision to probe via sh -lc (01KY0QQ1F1XVYYR5696B1N03S6) while preserving its principle — that decision mirrored the spawn when the spawn WAS sh -lc.
summary: SessionStart hook now spawns the launcher directly (sh, no login shell) for its availability probe
